title: Binance Options Will Launch Additional BNBUSDT Weekly Options
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Options will launch additional BNBUSDT Weekly Options on  2023-07-25  at  08:00 (UTC) .   Please note:   BNBUSDT Weekly Options are European-style options contracts. Binance Options will launch additional BNBUSDT Weekly Options on  2023-07-25  at  08:00 (UTC) . Thereafter, a new BNBUSDT Weekly Options contract will be listed every Thursday. Please note that there will be no new BNBUSDT Weekly Options listing on Thursdays if the new listing’s expiration date coincides with that of an existing BNBUSDT Options contract. Please refer to  Binance Options Contract Specifications  for more details.  Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. Thanks for your support! Binance Team 2023-07-24
